extension.summary: TV Streaming navigation presets for Kodi
extension.description: Install and update the TV Streaming Catalogue and Arctic Fuse 3 Standard preset. Optional installation and explicit backup required before changing navigation.

Applies a carefully backed-up custom home and hub arrangement using TMDb Helper. Also provides a browsable library of films, series, documentary categories, streaming services and Trakt recommendations. Designed for the current Kodi profile only. An optional, explicit action adds a TMDb Movies playback link. Does not change playback defaults or credentials.

extension.summary: Prototype of a See All-first movie widget.
extension.description: A non-destructive test: prepends See All to TMDb Helper Action movie results. Does not change your skin, players or TMDb Helper settings.

extension.summary: Tests scroll-triggered movie-poster fetching without page tiles.
extension.description: Standalone Action Movies lazy-wall prototype for Arctic Fuse 3. Does not change installed widgets, skin, Trakt or playback settings. This version tests limited incremental loading and basic movie-detail navigation.
